label: Aprendiz
note: Article 1 defines Aprendiz as a jockey below the jurisdictional win threshold; qualification details remain Chile-specific.

label: Apuesta Mutua
note: Article 1 defines pooled wagering distributed among winners after statutory deductions.

label: Handicaper
note: Article 1 defines the person assigned by each racecourse to distribute handicap weights.

label: Hipódromo Reconocido
note: Recognized racecourse is a Chile-specific regulatory qualification on the generic Racecourse Concept.

label: Jinete Profesional
note: Article 1 defines a licensed professional jockey; do not infer identical licensing conditions globally.

label: Preparador
note: Article 1 defines the racing professional responsible for training, care and supervision of racehorses.

label: Propietario
note: Article 1 defines the person or persons in whose name a horse is registered.

label: Reunión
note: Article 1 defines Reunión as a race day at a recognized racecourse; retained as Chile-scoped usage rather than global synonym flattening.
